payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over all split point pairs (l, r) using prefix sums to compute deletions, O(n^2) brute-force.
payload.rationale: The algorithm enumerates all possible partitions (p, q) of the original string, not using DP. Among given DP subtypes, dp_2d_state is closest due to the nested loop over two indices, but it is effectively a complete search.
